text_block_list.text: Hoping to take in the view, I visited the tower alongside Daring Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What a beautiful view!
It's so clear out, and the scenery is gorgeous♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, we can see clearly for miles!
Yeah, I can see clearly all the way to the horizon!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! You've got good taste!
This is our favorite spot around here.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You can see the horizon clearly from here!
Maybe we can even see El's homelandâª

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Beyond that horizon,
I bet Kentucky is waitin' for us!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No.
Kentucky is—in that, direction.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! You were all here!
Fufu, I understand. It makes you want to find a taste of home, doesn't it?♪"

After spending some fun time together like that
for a little while—

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text: Wait... hey, is this—really okay?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Que!? What's going on!?
What could have happened... Yes!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hey... look over there! There's smoke rising!

Looking in the direction Tap Dance City pointed,
there was a paper bag of some sort on the floor--
and white smoke was billowing out of it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No way... Could that be a suspicious object!?
...This is bad.
"Murmurs spread, and the tension rapidly mounted. It seemed the other patrons were beginning to notice the situation as well."
choice_data_list: (This is bad... Everyone's going to panic at this rate.)

text_block_list.text:
This is an observation deck high above the ground. Suspicious objects
are certainly a worry, but if we let anxiety swallow us,
things could get even more troublesome.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...—Calm down— This is a
mission— Secure— the safety of the people.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Right...! You are so right!
We cannot be making the little ones cry!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there must be something we can do.
First—let's get everyone to calm down!

Tap Dance City and Symboli Kris S
helped the security guards guide the crowd.

El Condor Pasa and Taiki Shuttle
talked to everyone to calm them down.

And while Daring Heart and I
were giving directions to some foreign touristsâ

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh!
No, don't go that way!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
!! This is bad, Trainer!
The child is... headed toward that paper bag—

I look in the direction Daring Heart is pointing.
A small child is approaching a smoking paper bag,
unaware of the danger...!
—The moment I realized, my body moved on its own.
(SKRRRRK—!!!!)

Practically rolling across the floor, I lunged forward,
reached out—and caught her small body firmly
with both hands.

text_block_list.name: Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
――!　Thank you for
saving my child...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! Splendid...!
You've really got what it takes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...! Fufu, that was amazing.
—Just like a hero in an action movie.

Afterward, a thorough investigation was conducted—
and it turned out the paper bag only contained dry ice,
posing no danger at all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness... It's completely back to normal.
Is it thanks to the hero by my side, I wonder?
choice_data_list: No, I was just completely absorbed in it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So your body just moved on its own?
Hehe, that's totally what a hero would do, isn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...You really are amazing.
You truly show so many different sides of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: A cool and clever look, too—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Even looking scared—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...I want to see more. Every little detail. I want to truly take in your expression... right 'now'—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, how silly of me.
I had such a strange thought just now.
Thinking, "I wish this moment would last a little longer."

Something was definitely different. For her,
what mattered was the ever-updating "present."
For her to want to "continue" it even longer...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Everything's fun when I'm with you. From teen dramas
to disaster movies, and even action flicks.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Because you always act it out with everything you've got."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're by my side,
I can be a wonderful heroine, too—
It's so exciting! ♪
choice_data_list: I'll keep showing new sides of myself from now on.
Then for now, don't think about anything else.
You had a fantastic expression on your face too!
You were the one with the amazing expression!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're by my side,
I can be a wonderful heroine, too—
It's so exciting! ♪
choice_data_list: I'll keep showing new sides of myself from now on.
Then for now, don't think about anything else.
You had a fantastic expression on your face too!
You were the one with the amazing expression!

text_block_list.text:
—Not just now, but the future too will surely be
brimming with so many vibrant colors.
So, I told them I'd be happy if they kept watching over me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. I'm really looking forward to it.
My perch... my hero.
I suggested turning our attention to the scenery. It was already dark outside, and a beautiful night view unfolded from the tower.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that's right. As long as I have this view,
I don't need anything else.
I won't think about a thing... for now.
I told her that my being able to fulfill my role and show all those different expressions was entirely thanks to how wonderful her own expressions were.
I told him that my being able to fulfill my role and show all those different expressions was entirely thanks to how wonderful his own expressions were.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. Then I promise I'll keep
shining right by your side.
